switches.question: Apply the STATIC-WEB baseline (layout, deploy, forms, SEO, a11y, headers)?
switches.description: Adopt the canonical static-web standard. Required for the rest of the switches to mean anything.

switches.question: Enforce the performance budget (Lighthouse mobile 90+, page weight <1MB, no auto-loading video)?
switches.description: Pre-ship check fails if Lighthouse mobile performance drops below 90.

switches.question: Enforce WCAG 2.1 AA (contrast, focus states, touch targets, labels)?
Ship security headers (HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, CSP)?
switches.description: Writes a host-appropriate snippet (.htaccess for cPanel hosts, _headers for Netlify) into deploy/ or the repo root.

switches.question: Use the honeypot convention for contact forms (hidden input named 'website')?
switches.description: Keeps the same CSS rule and form pattern usable across PHP mailer, Netlify Forms, and Formspree.
